rv.q: In Pursuit Of is as timely as it is ageless, a cautionary tale wrapped in a message of redemption.
Ultimately, In Pursuit Of is a world premiere worth seeing in Chicago and a production that invites meaningful conversation about the social issues it explores.
The story is fairly simple, but to be honest, it took 2 1/2 hours ( one 10 minute intermission) to lay it all out and the number os set changes was probably the most ever in this venue.
